final: WITH country_avgs AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_mean FROM country_avgs), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.avg_wins, om.overall_mean FROM country_avgs ca, overall_mean om WHERE ca.avg_wins > om.overall_mean), above_overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as above_overall_mean FROM above_overall), final AS (SELECT ao.avg_wins, ao.overall_mean, aom.above_overall_mean FROM above_overall ao, above_overall_mean aom WHERE ao.avg_wins > aom.above_overall_mean) SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as final_mean, AVG(avg_wins - overall_mean) as excess_over_overall, AVG(avg_wins - above_overall_mean) as excess_over_above_group FROM final
